{b}RESTful Web Services{/b} and {b}Insight to Action Framework{/b} are new features made available in this update. To enable the features, perform a modify install on the base installation and add in the new features.

{b}RESTful Web Services:{/b} The Business Intelligence platform RESTful Web Service SDK lets you access the BI platform using the HTTP protocol. You can use the SDK to log on to the platform, navigate the BI platform repository, access resources, and perform basic resource scheduling. This feature is required to save Dashboards models and Live Office documents to the repository after the update.

{b}Insight to Action Framework:{/b} The Insight to Action Framework enables you to invoke operational transactions in SAP and non-SAP applications that are defined using the Report-Report Interface in NetWeaver. This feature is supported by Crystal Reports and BusinessObjects Dashboards.

RESTful Web Services and Insight to Action Framework are new features made available in this update. To enable the features, perform a modify install on the base installation and add in the new features.

RESTful Web Services: The Business Intelligence platform RESTful Web Service SDK lets you access the BI platform using the HTTP protocol. You can use the SDK to log on to the platform, navigate the BI platform repository, access resources, and perform basic resource scheduling. This feature is required to save Dashboards models and Live Office documents to the repository after the update.

Insight to Action Framework: The Insight to Action Framework enables you to invoke operational transactions in SAP and non-SAP applications that are defined using the Report-Report Interface in NetWeaver. This feature is supported by Crystal Reports and BusinessObjects Dashboards.
